messages:
oncall-bot: [P1] Incoming page: Aurora (dedicated-vpc) canary - spike in 500s and tail latency. Alert: error_rate >= 5% for 5m. see: https://ops.internal/alerts/aurora-canary-500s

tara-m: acked. I'm on it. grabbing logs + runbook. tagging @matt-k

matt-k: on my way. can you confirm which artifact is pinned in aurora-dedicated-canary? I'll check the rollout.

tara-m: current pinned artifact: rwd-inference:2026-03-10-rc3 (via release-api) — saw fail rate start ~10:08 UTC. customer traffic routed to canary pool.

sasha: quick question — is this a model change or infra image? Aurora reported higher 95th latency and 500s that look like OOMs in logs.

tara-m: logs show 'kernel OOM' on worker-2 and 'kv-cache invalidation' errors. looks like quantized kernel mismatch? attaching snippet:

[code]
Mar 15 10:12:41 worker-2 rwd: ERROR KernelExec: failed: OOM when allocating tensor
Mar 15 10:12:43 worker-2 rwd: WARN KVCache: invalidation mismatch for model_id=redwood-open-7b-q4
[/code]

ryan: paging infra oncall @sasha if we need immediate rollback. Customer liaison @aurora-liaison — any visible impact on your side? severity?  

aurora-liaison: seeing ~12% of requests fail with 500s, chat flows drop out for enterprise users in EU region. Customers in Prod are affected; we're starting to get support tickets.

matt-k: ok, plan A: pin canary back to previous artifact rwd-inference:2026-02-26-stable. If that doesn't reduce errors in 5 minutes, route canary traffic to dedicated fallback pool.

tara-m: agree. initiating pinned artifact revert now. command:

[code]
# rollback pinned artifact for aurora canary
curl -X POST https://internal-api/release/pin \
  -d '{"pool":"aurora-dedicated-canary","artifact":"rwd-inference:2026-02-26-stable"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN'
[/code]

eng-release-bot: deploy started: pinning artifact -> rwd-inference:2026-02-26-stable for pool aurora-dedicated-canary. rollout id: r-92417

tara-m: rolling. monitoring metrics in realtime. @matt-k can you watch for KV cache warmup and OOMs clearing?

matt-k: watching. tailing logs.

[code]
kubectl -n aurora logs -l pool=aurora-dedicated-canary -f | grep -E \"ERROR|OOM|KVCache\"
[/code]

sasha: I'm preparing temporary routing policy to divert 30% of canary traffic to fallback-dedicated-pool (same tenant) if error_rate > 3% after 2m.

tara-m: good. 3m after pinning: metrics: error_rate down to 2.1%, 95th latency dropping. support tickets still trickling but stabilizing.

aurora-liaison: thanks — customers report chat sessions restored. will hold to see if any regression pops up.

eng-release-bot: rollout r-92417 succeeded. all canary pods serving artifact rwd-inference:2026-02-26-stable

ryan: handoff note — I'll take shift for next 2h to watch for regressions and coordinate with Aurora PM. tara, please attach this to postmortem and include pinned artifact delta + KV cache telemetry.

tara-m: will do. initial mitigation worked. marking incident as 'mitigated - rollback to pinned artifact'. Creating incident channel and assigning postmortem owners.

matt-k: follow-ups: investigate why 2026-03-10-rc3 introduced kernel-level OOMs — possibly quantization kernel mismatch; reproduce on dedicated canary infra and add preflight checks.

sasha: will add automatic pre-deploy kernel compatibility test to release pipeline.

aurora-liaison: appreciate the quick rollback. please keep us posted on timeline for root cause and permanent fix.

tara-m: noted. action items logged. closing slack thread — monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
